use_RigidObjectManager: use the RigidObjectManager to add, remove, and query rigid objects in the physics simulation scene
use_ArticulatedObjectManager: use the ArticulatedObjectManager to add, remove, and query articulated objects with joints in the scene
configure_MotionType: configure MotionType to set static, kinematic, or dynamic motion behavior for physics objects
use_CollisionGroups: use CollisionGroups and CollisionGroupHelper to define which objects collide with each other in the simulation
configure_JointMotorSettings: configure JointMotorSettings with JointMotorType to control motor behavior on articulated object joints
